title: W3Schools: Zip Lists to Dictionary
description: Given a list of string `keys` and a list of integer `values` of equal length, combine them into a dictionary using zip.
constraints:
0 <= len(keys) == len(values) <= 10^4
• Time: O(N) | Space: O(N)
starter_code:
def zip_to_dict(keys: list[str], values: list[int]) -> dict:
    pass
solution:
def zip_to_dict(keys: list[str], values: list[int]) -> dict:
    return dict(zip(keys, values))
explanation: Zips parallel iterables into dictionary in O(N) time.
